questions.prompt: A DNS query and a DNS response use the same message format.
Which section holds QNAME, QCLASS, and QTYPE?
Which header flag means the response came from a server that runs the zone, not from a cache? (two letters)
Why does a response repeat the question section?
options: So the client can match the response to what it asked (along with the header's ID)
Because the server forgot the question

questions.prompt: A referral from a TLD server lists NS records for the next zone down. Which section are they in?
Which QTYPE asks for an entire zone, every record in it? (four letters)
What single character is the QTYPE for "all records for this name"?
